notes.title: Alpha v.5 changelog
notes.notes:
-Base building-
You can now reposition some structures/items.
New structures:
	New safe house
	Water tank
	Antenna (allows you to use your map) 
	Soil fertilizer (allows you to plant trees)
Improved solar panels model


-Sled and kayak-
-kayak and sled improved compass system
-increased kayak speed, changed main color and proportions
-Sled dogs menu and eating/drinking states improved 
-dogs with low health will not be able to pull the sled.

-Storms-
-storms now last a whole day and you can play through them.
-you now collect more data from weather monitors during storms. 
-radically improved storms particle system.
-Getting ready for a storms now requires energy instead of wood.

-Planting-
Planting trees or plants now requires a nearby “Soil fertilizer”
New pines you can place in your base
	Pine: drops pine seeds that allow you to keep expanding your garden
	Med pine: gives medicinal leaves
	Nest pine: drops bird eggs daily
	Rest pine: restores the dogs’ energy when they are nearby
	

-Fishing-
Fishing now requires bait, you can get bait by creating a grass patch and collecting worms.

-Tools-
Binoculars now hide the crosshair when being used
Improved compass model and interface

-Data-
New data spots icons
New data spots animation 

-Base camp -
You can now withdraw wood from the basecamp whenever you want
New npcs UI

Fixes:
Fixed anti-aliasing bug that forced you to have anti-aliasing ON
fixed "irregular terrain" constantly when placing most structures
fixed bow aiming or binoculars zooming in when placing stuff from the build menu.
Fixed inventory lagging for a sec when turned on
fixed fisher npc checking arrows instead of meat supplies when you send them on a fishing trip.
fixed hardware welder stuck rotation bug
fixed weird shadown on kayak when fishing 
fixed waypoint placing system 
fixed crosshair showing when using binoculars
fixed crosshair showing when placing objects q

coop fixes
fixed missing P2 sled
fixed game lagging after a long coop session
fixed P2 resources and building UI
fixed map not working for player 2

notes.title: alpha v.4 huge content update
notes.notes:
Please start a new game so everything works properly

Changelog: 

-Map: added tons of new things to explore including icebergs.

New tool
-Binoculars: right click to zoom in and left click to set a waypoint towards the area you are looking at.

STRUCTURES/BASE CAMP
-Astrophotography kit: dynamic way of collecting data.
-Tall flag
-Data scanner
-Camera traps
-Improved light: you can now change the color of the lights you place
-every single structure has been rescaled and optimized
-Small rocks added as a decor to big structures. 
-new lumber mill model and props.
-new hardware welder model and props.
-new tent model
-new water deposit model.
-new sfx when placing structures.
-“unpacking process” after placing a structure the npc in charge has to unpack his equipment before being able to work.

STARTING A NEW GAME
-Choose expedition flag color
-Choose your specialty (geologist, biologist, and meteorologist) this will allow you to collect more data from some items/structures.
-improved dog naming process.

ITEMS
-Tissue/cell sample: get it from dead animals and algae.
-Camera sd: camera traps 

ANIMALS
-Walrus
-Seal
-Orca (rare spawns)

DATA SCANNER
-A new structure that allows you to retrieve data from items you find in the map, including damaged hard drives and skin samples.

PETITIONS/UPLOADING DATA
-Uploading data will now grant exposure which translates into signatures for your petitions to protect marine areas, a larger marine area under protection means a higher positive impact on the ecosystem.

CAMERA TRAPS
-Regular traps have been replaced by camera traps, small autonomous cameras that track the movement of animals. They must be placed close to dens, you can retrieve the camera SD every day and use a data scanner to convert it into data. 

SOLAR PANESL
-This is the new energy producing structure, they follow the sun and only generate power while the sun is up.

NPCS
- Distinct idle animation, improved interaction process. 

STARTING ZONE
-A radically improved starting area, npcs that provide tips and more.
- You can now send a pilot on recruitment trips by providing the food required for the new members.

OTHER
-Sled: sled will go slower when going uphill
-kayak: you can now use your kayak by simply standing close to water and pressing “E” 
-Added inventory menu animations
-updated help menu
-added special data collection areas
-added algae growing on thin ice in some areas around the island
-Each animal now gives a distinct amount of meat, and also animal cell samples. 

Some of the fixes:
-huge optimization improvement
-fixed input bug that was heavily affecting the game’s performance.
-fixed antialiasing/ssao bug that caused frame drops when getting too close to npcs or game objects.
-fixed seeing through objects if you were close enough (camera bug) 
-fixed color correction bug that was causing camera artifacts to appear on dark surfaces. 
-fixed water rendering before distant trees 
-fixed stars not rendering 
-fixed penguins not spawning when loading/continuing a game. 
-fixed penguins rotation bug
-fixed “Quit” menu button.
-Smaller, cleaner UI when interacting with expedition members. 
- fixed weather monitors and ice drills resource check bug.
-fixed co-op player animation system breaking after some time.

notes.title: alpha v.32 changelog
notes.notes:
These are the major changes in alpha v.32

-The expedition update adds a new objective to the game “Data collection”, you will be able to place weather monitors, collect data from buoys in the open sea, and then upload this data to get different rewards (from critical items like med kits to items that will allow you to customize the look of your base)

-Added small intro

-Animal AI: deer, lion, wolf will now evade trees when they either chasing or running away from you.

-Npcs now have their own name and “efficiency” level, this affects how they perform the tasks assigned by the player. I.E a hunter with a high efficiency level will bring more meat after a hunting trip. 

-Npcs now sleep, this makes them unavailable for work at certain hours.
-You can now customize the look of your base by using paint buckets.

-Major improvements to the building process, now you are able to see how large structures will be placed and everything is more dynamic. 

-New structures: 

-Hardware welder (replaces metal gatherer, and hardware components replace the “metal” resource)
-Antenna: Allows you to upload data, an antenna is also required to start setting up a new base.
-Eco-ranger: Makes use of local data to go on eco-friendly campaigns which will improve the health of the ecosystem.
-Tent: cheap to build, allows you to sleep and save your game anywhere.
-Weather monitor, ice caps monitor: use them to gather data every dayl

-Storms no longer send you back in time, they will now wipe your resources and local data if you do not meet the demands. 

-New map with improved flow and balance. 

-Day/night transition system color palette revised and improved. 

-New ambient occlusion technique. 

-Player 2 is now able to build some structures, including: traps, weather and ice caps monitor,

notes.title: alpha v.32 changelog
notes.notes:
These are the major changes in alpha v.32

-The expedition update adds a new objective to the game “Data collection”, you will be able to place weather monitors, collect data from buoys in the open sea, and then upload this data to get different rewards (from critical items like med kits to items that will allow you to customize the look of your base)

-Added small intro

-Animal AI: deer, lion, wolf will now evade trees when they either chasing or running away from you.

-Npcs now have their own name and “efficiency” level, this affects how they perform the tasks assigned by the player. I.E a hunter with a high efficiency level will bring more meat after a hunting trip. 

-Npcs now sleep, this makes them unavailable for work at certain hours.
-You can now customize the look of your base by using paint buckets.

-Major improvements to the building process, now you are able to see how large structures will be placed and everything is more dynamic. 

-New structures: 

-Hardware welder (replaces metal gatherer, and hardware components replace the “metal” resource)
-Antenna: Allows you to upload data, an antenna is also required to start setting up a new base.
-Eco-ranger: Makes use of local data to go on eco-friendly campaigns which will improve the health of the ecosystem.
-Tent: cheap to build, allows you to sleep and save your game anywhere.
-Weather monitor, ice caps monitor: use them to gather data every dayl

-Storms no longer send you back in time, they will now wipe your resources and local data if you do not meet the demands. 

-New map with improved flow and balance. 

-Day/night transition system color palette revised and improved. 

-New ambient occlusion technique. 

-Player 2 is now able to build some structures, including: traps, weather and ice caps monitor, 

-Huge improvements to the UI.

-Penguins.

-You can now change between gun and tools by using keys 1,2,3,4,5

-Your arms and tools now take less space in the screen.

notes.title: v.223 changelog
notes.notes:
note: I'm very tired atm so I might be missing some stuff.

-General gameplay changes-

Dying will no longer send you to the main menu, instead you will re spawn at your main village but your loot will be gone (including raw meat that was not stored).

Increased initial resources amount.

Added fishing (find fish on lakes and rivers)

you can now send villagers on hunting trips by providing the required resources.

You can now place structures by hitting the interaction key (E)

Animals, camps, berries now re-spawn after each storm.

In order to build deer or bear buff structure you will need to collect special items (deer horn and bear paw) 


VILLAGE

improved structures aesthetics.

Added snow mask and backpack with tools to villagers (aesthetic)

now you can store food in any settlement (removed food storage structure)

New lumber mill and metal gatherer model.

New energy generator model.

Lumber mill and metal gatherer no long require a villager to operate.

Improved safe house and research center interior.

Improved workshop, clinic and armory interior.

Max number of structures per settlement limit removed.

Bear and deer buff now require “bear paw” and “deer horn” items.

Reduced amount of resources required to survive each storm.

Fixed storms not draining resources when they hit.

Added small object indicating when resources are not available to resource gatherers.

Improved safe house interior and added light fx to the stove when cooking or boiling water.





---Terrain and visuals---

Lots of terrain and location edition
Modified tree height, color combination and density.
Modified grass and snow colors.
Modified camera filters.
Modified rifle and crossbow size.
Modified player 3d model, new backpack and snow mask.
Modified water look and color.
Villagers glow when you interact with them.
Improved Anti-aliasing 


--User interface --
Sleep menu / crafting menu / cooking menu were improved.
New UI colors, cleaner design and easier to read text.
Fixed and improved co-op (multiplayer) menu.
Improved inventory design
Drastically improved help menu.
New building system visuals.

Fixed
Massive animal spawn system optimization.
Wolf hit box.

notes.title: Plans for the new update
notes.notes:
Maybe you noticed that the game has not received any updates in the last 2 weeks, well it is not for a bad reason. I am currently working on a pretty big update that aims to give more life to Eternal Winter, these are the key things that this update should adress once done (by the end of march).
-Fishing huts (yes you will be able to fish)
-edible plants (they will be rare but they will be there)
-Rework to how the general atmosphere of the game looks and feels, mainly the day/night cycle will be reworked so it shows more dramatic/beautiful colors rather than dull ones.
-many small fx to make the overall experience more immersive
-and more!

So hold on tight, the wait will be worth it.

 [*]wildlife: bears now do twice the damage to dogs and you
 [*]shooting/hunting: now you can retrieve arrows from dead animals
 [*]shooting/hunting: bullet speed increased
 [*]dogs: now dogs restore part of their energy depending on the amount of hours you sleep
 [*]dogs: when one of your dogs die your game is saved
 [*]Map: added some kind of interior (furniture,trash) to 75% of the abandoned houses
 [*]Map: fixed most of the houses that look like they were dragged  by snow
 [*]Sleeping: you can now sleep/save your game in abandoned cars
 [*]FX: added a small wind fx to trees, their leaves will now move
 [*]FX: added a wind sfx 

The next update will be focused on fixing some of the bugs you have been reporting, then I will move on to a HUGE map focused update.

notes.title: Plans for the first update
notes.notes: The first update will focus on house interiors, I will work to make the interior of the abandoned houses feel way more immersive. It should be up by this thursday or friday. Also I will fix some of the bugs you guys are reporting and probably work on the balancing side of the game, many players have reported that their dogs can kill a bear and that is not right. Also I will add more places where you can take shelter and sleep for the night. And the last thing you will be able to sleep in cars, but the risk of losing calories will be higher.
